Use-case map

Pick the job, then pick the file.

Building a new app

Start with templates/html/command-deck.html or templates/html/mobile-app-shell.html. Copy assets into the app and reuse kx-card, kx-btn, kx-grid, kx-console.

Making a client pitch

Start with templates/html/client-pitch.html. Replace the promise, proof, CTA, and client details.

Making a portfolio

Start with templates/html/personal-portfolio.html. Add project cards and proof links.

Making a music/artist page

Start with templates/html/music-artist-profile.html. Add cover art, player, price, bio, and purchase link.

Making social graphics

Open social-cards/*.html in the browser, edit text, screenshot/export at square ratio.

Adding icons to existing work

Copy assets/icons into your project and use normal img tags. SVG files are transparent and editable.

React use

Copy components/react/KaixuComponents.jsx and import the two CSS files globally.
